summary: Implemented passive homogeneous Sellmeier medium support across the public API, typed IR, coefficient compilation, and the shared PoleResidue-family update-kernel path, with examples and validation tests passing.
key_findings: Added a Phase 1 `Sellmeier` model with `(B_i, C_i)` coefficients, direct `eps_model()` evaluation, passive-subset validation, and single-pole `from_dispersion()` fitting.
Lowered `Sellmeier` into typed `SellmeierIR` while compiling runtime coefficients by converting to an equivalent `PoleResidue`, preserving the public family tag as `medium_type="Sellmeier"`.

Kept runtime support on the existing complex-polarization auxiliary-state layout, so Sellmeier execution reuses `PoleResidueMaterialCoefficients` and `pole_residue_electric_update()` instead of introducing a parallel kernel contract.
Added representative tests for model validation, formula correctness, IR emission, scene compilation, and shared-kernel execution; full test suite now passes.

artifacts.description: Added the Sellmeier public model, coefficient validation, direct permittivity evaluation, pole-residue lowering, and passive dispersion fitting helper.
Added Sellmeier coefficient compilation onto the shared PoleResidue auxiliary-state contract and routed generic medium compilation through it.
Added typed `SellmeierIR` lowering and medium-IR dispatch support.
Added representative Sellmeier validation, compilation, IR, scene, and kernel-path tests.
Added a Sellmeier compilation example showing public-model, pole-residue lowering, and compiled coefficient outputs.
Recorded Sellmeier support decisions and the shared runtime-contract choice for later material-family tasks.

follow_up_notes: Lorentz, Drude, and Debye can follow the same pattern: keep family-specific public and IR models, but lower onto the existing PoleResidue-family auxiliary-state runtime contract whenever the formulation permits it.
